hook.en: Why does salted ikan masin last for months without a fridge? Why do vegetables go limp in salty water but crisp up again in plain water? Every cell decides what comes in and what goes out — through its plasma membrane.
hook.bm: Mengapa ikan masin tahan berbulan-bulan tanpa peti sejuk? Mengapa sayur menjadi layu dalam air garam tetapi segar semula dalam air biasa? Setiap sel menentukan apa yang masuk dan keluar — melalui membran plasmanya.

bigIdeas.en: The plasma membrane is a semi-permeable phospholipid bilayer with proteins (fluid mosaic model).
bigIdeas.bm: Membran plasma ialah dwilapisan fosfolipid separa telap dengan protein (model mozek bendalir).

bigIdeas.en: Passive transport (diffusion, facilitated diffusion, osmosis) needs no energy and goes down a concentration gradient.
bigIdeas.bm: Pengangkutan pasif (resapan, resapan berbantu, osmosis) tidak memerlukan tenaga dan mengikut kecerunan kepekatan.

bigIdeas.en: Active transport uses ATP and carrier proteins to move substances against the gradient.
bigIdeas.bm: Pengangkutan aktif menggunakan ATP dan protein pembawa untuk menggerakkan bahan melawan kecerunan.

bigIdeas.en: Hypotonic, isotonic and hypertonic solutions affect animal and plant cells differently.
bigIdeas.bm: Larutan hipotonik, isotonik dan hipertonik memberi kesan berbeza kepada sel haiwan dan tumbuhan.

definition.en: Lets some substances through but not others.
definition.bm: Membenarkan sesetengah bahan melaluinya tetapi tidak yang lain.

definition.en: Net movement of particles from high to low concentration.
definition.bm: Pergerakan bersih zarah dari kepekatan tinggi ke rendah.

definition.en: Diffusion of water molecules across a semi-permeable membrane from a dilute to a concentrated solution.
definition.bm: Resapan molekul air merentasi membran separa telap dari larutan cair ke larutan pekat.

definition.en: Diffusion through channel or carrier proteins, no energy used.
definition.bm: Resapan melalui protein liang atau pembawa, tanpa tenaga.

definition.en: Movement against the concentration gradient using carrier proteins and ATP.
definition.bm: Pergerakan melawan kecerunan kepekatan menggunakan protein pembawa dan ATP.

definition.en: Plasma membrane pulls away from the cell wall as a plant cell loses water.
definition.bm: Membran plasma tertarik jauh dari dinding sel apabila sel tumbuhan kehilangan air.

definition.en: Red blood cell bursts in a hypotonic solution.
definition.bm: Sel darah merah pecah dalam larutan hipotonik.

question.en: Potato strips are placed in sucrose solutions of different concentrations for 30 minutes. In which solution does the length not change, and what does it tell you?
question.bm: Jalur kentang diletakkan dalam larutan sukrosa pelbagai kepekatan selama 30 minit. Dalam larutan manakah panjangnya tidak berubah, dan apakah maknanya?

steps.en: In dilute solutions the strips gain water by osmosis and become longer (hypotonic).
steps.bm: Dalam larutan cair, jalur menerima air secara osmosis dan menjadi lebih panjang (hipotonik).

steps.en: In concentrated solutions they lose water and shorten (hypertonic).
steps.bm: Dalam larutan pekat, jalur kehilangan air dan memendek (hipertonik).

steps.en: Plot change in length against concentration; where the line crosses zero, the solution is isotonic.
steps.bm: Plot perubahan panjang melawan kepekatan; di mana garis memotong sifar, larutan isotonik.

answer.en: The concentration where length doesn't change is isotonic to the potato cell sap.
answer.bm: Kepekatan yang tidak mengubah panjang adalah isotonik dengan sap sel kentang.

prompt.en: The plasma membrane is mainly made of…

explanation.en: Fluid mosaic model: phospholipids, proteins, cholesterol and glycoproteins.
explanation.bm: Model mozek bendalir: fosfolipid, protein, kolesterol dan glikoprotein.

prompt.en: Which substance can pass directly through the phospholipid bilayer?
prompt.bm: Bahan manakah boleh melalui terus dwilapisan fosfolipid?

explanation.en: Small, non-polar molecules (O₂, CO₂) and lipid-soluble substances diffuse through the bilayer. Glucose and ions need proteins.
explanation.bm: Molekul kecil tidak berkutub (O₂, CO₂) dan bahan larut lipid meresap melalui dwilapisan. Glukosa dan ion memerlukan protein.

prompt.en: Match each process to its description.

right.en: Down the gradient, directly through the bilayer
Down the gradient, through carrier/channel proteins
Water molecules from dilute to concentrated solution
right.bm: Molekul air dari larutan cair ke pekat

prompt.en: Root hair cells absorb mineral ions from soil even though the ion concentration is higher inside the cell. This is…
prompt.bm: Sel rambut akar menyerap ion mineral dari tanah walaupun kepekatan ion lebih tinggi di dalam sel. Ini ialah…

explanation.en: Moving against the concentration gradient requires energy (ATP) — active transport.
explanation.bm: Bergerak melawan kecerunan kepekatan memerlukan tenaga (ATP) — pengangkutan aktif.

prompt.en: Red blood cells are placed in distilled water. What happens?
prompt.bm: Sel darah merah diletakkan dalam air suling. Apakah yang berlaku?

explanation.en: Distilled water is hypotonic; water enters by osmosis and animal cells have no cell wall to stop bursting.
explanation.bm: Air suling hipotonik; air masuk secara osmosis dan sel haiwan tiada dinding sel untuk menghalang pecah.

prompt.en: Onion epidermis cells are placed in concentrated salt solution. The plasma membrane pulls away from the cell wall. This is called…
prompt.bm: Sel epidermis bawang diletakkan dalam larutan garam pekat. Membran plasma tertarik jauh dari dinding sel. Ini dipanggil…

explanation.en: Hypertonic solution: water leaves the vacuole by osmosis. Putting it back in water reverses it (deplasmolysis).
explanation.bm: Larutan hipertonik: air keluar dari vakuol secara osmosis. Meletakkannya semula dalam air membalikkannya (deplasmolisis).

prompt.en: Select ALL processes that rely on diffusion in the human body.
prompt.bm: Pilih SEMUA proses yang bergantung pada resapan dalam badan manusia.

options.en: Oxygen moving from alveoli into blood
options.bm: Oksigen bergerak dari alveolus ke dalam darah

options.en: Carbon dioxide moving from tissue cells into blood
options.bm: Karbon dioksida bergerak dari sel tisu ke dalam darah

options.en: Some glucose absorbed in the villi
Pumping blood out of the heart

explanation.en: Gas exchange and some absorption use diffusion; the heart pumps by muscle contraction.
explanation.bm: Pertukaran gas dan sebahagian penyerapan menggunakan resapan; jantung mengepam melalui pengecutan otot.

prompt.en: Why does salting fish preserve it?

options.en: Salt draws water out of bacterial cells by osmosis, killing them
options.bm: Garam menarik air keluar dari sel bakteria secara osmosis, membunuhnya

explanation.en: The hypertonic environment dehydrates microorganisms (plasmolysis/crenation). Sugar in jam works the same way.
explanation.bm: Persekitaran hipertonik menyahhidratkan mikroorganisma. Gula dalam jem berfungsi dengan cara yang sama.

prompt.en: A farmer adds too much fertiliser and the plants wilt. Explain.
prompt.bm: Seorang petani menabur terlalu banyak baja dan tumbuhan menjadi layu. Terangkan.

options.en: Soil solution becomes hypertonic, so root cells lose water by osmosis
options.bm: Larutan tanah menjadi hipertonik, jadi sel akar kehilangan air secara osmosis

options.en: Roots absorb too much water and burst
options.bm: Akar menyerap terlalu banyak air dan pecah

explanation.en: Water moves out of root hairs into the concentrated soil solution; cells become flaccid and the plant wilts.
explanation.bm: Air bergerak keluar dari rambut akar ke larutan tanah yang pekat; sel menjadi flasid dan tumbuhan layu.

prompt.en: The diffusion of water molecules across a semi-permeable membrane is called ______.
prompt.bm: Resapan molekul air merentasi membran separa telap dipanggil ______.

explanation.en: Water moves from a region of higher water potential (dilute) to lower (concentrated).
explanation.bm: Air bergerak dari kawasan keupayaan air tinggi (cair) ke rendah (pekat).
